DeterminationBasis: T16-006 requires an independent-verification claim to preserve an explicit bounded verified scope. T16-024 separately requires each additional claimed property to have its own identifiable evidence basis and bounded verification method and forbids silently transferring support from one property to another. Together these controls prevent independent verification from expanding the claim beyond properties actually supported within the bounded verification scope.

Existing T03 controls establish identifiable authority, reassessment after authority-condition change, and separation of technical capability from governance authority, but no existing T03 control tests the distinct invariant that an exception cannot create authority beyond the scope granted by its governing exception rule. A dedicated exception-authority scope test is therefore required.
